Home - The Wind Castle
The Wind Castle
Memories that will last forever
view Rooms & Suites
welcome to The Wind Castle
Nuwara Eliya, Sri Lanka
The Wind Castle hotel commands an impressive presence in the form of an ancient Scottish-style castle set atop a hill offering stunning views of the surrounding lush green mountains of Nuwara Eliya while facing the tallest mountain in Sri Lanka the famed Pidurutalagala Mountain (Mount Pedro).
The constant flow of a fresh, cool and gentle wind through the mountains is where the hotel derives its name from.
DISCOVER Rooms & Suites
DOUBLE ROOM / 225 SQFT / 2 ADULTS The Double Rooms
The Castle offers Six Varieties of Double Rooms names as The Rose Meadow, The Outcrop, The Wilderness, The Summit, The
Rock Retreat, The Jungle Retreat for you to choose from.
details
FAMILY ROOM / 400 SQFT / 4 ADULTS The Family Club
Family Club is a large and homely room for the entire family with two adjacent bedrooms, one bath room, double beds in each and a panoramic view of the mountains.
details
FAMILY ROOM / 500 SQFT / 4 ADULTS The Royal Rest
Royal Rest is a luxurious suite for families or honeymooners. It offers a panoramic view of the Mountain through massive glass panes and is perfect for those seeking privacy, peace and solitude.

A sheer elegance-must visit
The Wind Castle a sheer elegance ❤️ We absolutely loved the stay... it was like being with homies, Chalika and Nandani were like family to us... Food was delicious and it was too much for us... yummy!!! Ambiance was completely elegant and loved every flower to its very petal..

Simply Perfect !
The location and view is amazing. The hotel is very clean the rooms have a really nice ambiance. The overall hotel aesthetic is really nice. The best part of our visit was the staff. We were so welcome there. The staff was really helpful and the Manger Chalika was really friendly and supportive.

Rooms & Suites - The Wind Castle
Rooms Suites
Home
Rooms Suites
DISCOVER Rooms & Suites
DOUBLE ROOM / 225 SQFT / 2 ADULTS The Rose Meadow
‘Rose Meadow’ allows easy access through its French windows to the perfectly manicured garden with roses in full bloom emanating their classic sweet scents, and affords a panoramic view of the mountains.
details
DOUBLE ROOM / 225 SQFT / 2 ADULTS The Outcrop
‘The Outcrop’ has a specious balcony that offers a spectacular view of the garden below and the tower of this mini castle called ‘The Cone’ is adjacent to this room.
details
TRIPLE ROOM / 225 SQFT / 2 ADULTS The Wilderness
‘The Wilderness’ has a specious balcony that offers a spectacular view of the garden below and the surrounding forests, a wide sitting area and a spacious bathroom.
details
DOUBLE ROOM / 225 SQFT / 2 ADULTS The Summit
‘The Summit’ faces the tallest mountain in Sri Lanka – Piduruthalagala – and offers a panoramic view of the of the Nuwara Eliya town. The room has an ambiance of being suspended in the skies.
details
DOUBLE ROOM / 225 SQFT / 2 ADULTS Rock Retreat
Rock Retreat offers a panoramic view of the picturesque mountains and the vegetable garden from its large balcony.
details
DOUBLE ROOM / 225 SQFT / 2 ADULTS Jungle Retreat
Jungle Retreat is a large room with a luxuriously appointed attached bathroom. The large balcony offers a spectacular view of the surrounding forest and vegetable garden.
details
FAMILY ROOM / 400 SQFT / 4 ADULTS The Family Club
Family Club is a large and homely room for the entire family with two adjacent bedrooms,one bath room, double beds in each and a panoramic view of the mountains. One side of this room is attached to The Cone of the hotel.
details
FAMILY ROOM / 500 SQFT / 4 ADULTS The Royal Rest
‘Royal Rest’ is a luxuriously appointed 60 Sqm suite for families and honeymooning couples. It offers a panoramic view of the Piduruthalagala Mountain through massive glass panes and is perfect for those seeking privacy, peace and solitude.

FAQ - The Wind Castle
FAQ
Home
FAQ
General Questions
What Accomodations are made for visitors with Disabilities?
We have handicapped restrooms on the 86th Floor Observatory and also have lowered viewing walls and binoculars. Service dogs are allowed throughout the building. Motorized and non-motorized wheelchairs are permitted. The 86th Floor has ramps to make getting around easier and lowered viewing walls so that visitors in chairs can still take in the view. The 102nd Floor currently has a higher wall, but we are working to make it more accessible to all our visitors.
